# Yotpo
> Yotpo is an eCommerce retention and AI-visibility platform that helps brands get found, earn trust, and turn one-time shoppers into repeat customers and advocates. Its core connected products - Reviews & UGC and Loyalty & Referrals - run on shared first-party shopper data, and its AI suite (CommerceGPT / Answer Engine Optimization) helps brands stay visible inside AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and agentic-commerce shopping experiences. Yotpo integrates deeply with Shopify, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Adobe Commerce (Magento), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WooCommerce and 150+ marketing, CX and commerce tools.
This file follows the llms.txt convention (see https://llmstxt.org). It is a curated, human-maintained map of the most useful, evergreen URLs on https://www.yotpo.com, intended to help LLMs and AI search/answer engines understand Yotpo's products, evidence, and educational content. Every URL below was verified live. Deep inventories (1,190+ glossary entries, 4,080+ blog posts, 165+ integrations, 100+ case studies) are linked at their hub pages rather than enumerated in full.
## Key facts
- Company: Yotpo Ltd., an eCommerce retention marketing platform.
- Core products: Reviews & UGC (including visual UGC) and Loyalty & Referrals, plus AI Visibility (CommerceGPT / Answer Engine Optimization).
- Core commerce platforms: Shopify & Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Adobe Commerce / Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WooCommerce.
- Positioning: a connected retention stack built on shared first-party shopper data, focused on reviews, loyalty and AI visibility.
- AI crawler policy: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, GoogleOther and Applebot are all explicitly allowed in robots.txt.

## Products
- [Reviews & UGC](https://www.yotpo.com/ratings-and-reviews/): Collect and display product reviews, ratings, photos and Q&A; syndication and rich results.
- [Visual UGC](https://www.yotpo.com/platform/visual-ugc/): Curate customer photos/videos and shoppable galleries across site and social.
- [Customer Video Reviews](https://www.yotpo.com/customer-video-reviews/): Collect and display video reviews.
- [Loyalty & Referrals](https://www.yotpo.com/platform/loyalty/): Points, rewards, VIP tiers and referral programs to drive repeat purchases.
- [Insights](https://www.yotpo.com/platform/insights/): Cross-product analytics, dashboards and shopper data insights.
- [Yotpo for Enterprise](https://www.yotpo.com/enterprise/): Enterprise-grade loyalty, reviews and retention.
- [Enterprise Loyalty](https://www.yotpo.com/yotpo-enterprise-loyalty/): Loyalty built for large/omnichannel brands.

 Yotpo Discover 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Featured Updates
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Yotpo Discover
 
 
 
Discover MCP Integration
 
Connect Claude to Yotpo Discover and work with your brand’s AI visibility data in one place. Pull insights, generate content, check citation performance, and run recurring workflows without switching tools.
 
 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
REVIEWS & UGC
 
 
 
Product Matching Tool
 
Help more reviews reach the right retailer pages with smarter product matching across your catalog and retailer catalogs, including AI-suggested matches and manual tools for products that need review.
 
 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Yotpo Discover
 
 
 
Discover Onsite Agent
 
See which pages need attention for AI visibility. The Onsite Agent scans key pages, surfaces strengths and gaps, and helps teams prioritize what to update first.
 
 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
REVIEWS & UGC
 
 
 
 
Manage Reviews Workspace 
 
Built for speed and clarity, the new advanced moderation workspace saves your team hours on daily review management without missing what matters.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
REVIEWS & UGC
 
 
 
 
Reviews for Bundled Products
 
Use the reviews you already collected on bundled products. Show shoppers relevant feedback from the individual items inside each bundle, without starting from zero.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LOYALTY & REFERRALS
 
 
 
 
Yotpo Spotlight
 
Drive high-value actions with a mobile-first loyalty hub featuring smart CTAs. Boost engagement by showing status, points, and rewards (including free products) to logged-in or logged-out shoppers, guiding them through your website journey.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
INTEGRATIONS
 
LOYALTY & REFERRALS
 
 
 
 
Postscript SMS Integration
 
Connect Yotpo Loyalty with Postscript to power personalized SMS campaigns using real-time loyalty data. Trigger messages based on points balance, VIP tier, and rewards to drive engagement, repeat purchases, and loyalty program participation.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
INTEGRATIONS
 
 
 
 
Klaviyo Customer Hub
 
Embed loyalty directly inside Klaviyo Customer Hub. Let customers view points, redeem rewards, and refer friends - all from a personalized on-site drawer experience. No redirects. No friction. Just seamless loyalty engagement.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LOYALTY & REFERRALS
 
 
 
 
Loyalty Tiers
 
Create automatic loyalty journeys with advanced tiers. Use Shopify tags and API rules to reward specific behaviors like events or hidden VIPs, giving you flexibility and control.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
REVIEWS & UGC
 
 
 
 
Reviews Atlas
 
Optimize your PDP reviews for conversion. Get insights into quality, authenticity, and recency, plus guidance on refining your strategy to secure sales-driving reviews.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
REVIEWS & UGC
 
 
 
 
Reviews Translation
 
Localize your entire reviews experience, including AI summaries and filters, with pre- and on-demand translations powered by AWS and optimized by region for maximum impact.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
INTEGRATIONS
 
LOYALTY & REFERRALS
 
 
 
 
Novel Partnership
 
Mobile-first experience with frictionless in-store redemption, personalized push notifications, and incentives for pass downloads. Exclusive Novel discount available.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
INTEGRATIONS
 
REVIEWS & UGC
 
 
 
 
Attentive x Reviews
 
Leverage authentic customer voices in your marketing. Pull reviews and UGC into campaigns, recommend products based on ratings, and display social proof at the moment of decision to drive higher conversions.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
INTEGRATIONS
 
LOYALTY & REFERRALS
 
 
 
 
Tapcart Integration
 
Reward every action in your app to drive downloads and boost push opt-ins. Give your best customers mobile-only perks. Make earning, tracking, and redeeming rewards effortless.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
INTEGRATIONS
 
LOYALTY & REFERRALS
 
 
 
 
Attentive x Loyalty
 
Connect Yotpo Loyalty with Attentive SMS & Email to sync member data, trigger targeted campaigns, and personalize messages—driving deeper engagement and loyalty.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
INTEGRATIONS
 
REVIEWS & UGC
 
 
 
 
Siena AI
 
Auto-moderate reviews, respond in your brand's voice, and capture key insights to build trust, personalize touchpoints, and get time back to focus on growing your brand.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
REVIEWS & UGC
 
 
 
 
Smart Views
 
Automatically route review insights to the right teams - so product, marketing, and support get the feedback that matters most to them, and your entire business can act faster.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LOYALTY & REFERRALS
 
 
 
 
Post Checkout Referral
 
Capture post-purchase momentum with easy referrals on Thank You page. Shoppers share ready-to-share links via preferred method, no login or dev work. Boost referrals effortlessly!
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LOYALTY & REFERRALS
 
 
 
 
Shopify Metafields
 
Sync loyalty data across Shopify, ESPs, and CRMs for deeper personalization. Automate exclusive discounts and use Flows to auto-tag milestones, powering dynamic storefronts.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LOYALTY & REFERRALS
 
 
 
 
Loyalty Account Extension 
 
Shopify Customer Accounts users can now access our Loyalty Account Extension. Customers can view points, tier status, join the program, or redeem rewards directly from their account page—motivating sign-ups and driving purchases with key info.
 
 
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
REVIEWS & UGC
 
 
 
 
AI Reviews Summary
 
Showcase a concise summary of key topics from your reviews, enabling shoppers to make quicker, more confident purchase decisions.
 
 
 
 Learn more

Revenue Performance Dashboard

LOYALTY & REFERRALS
